annotations.exact_quote: Label Distribution Learning (LDL) models supervision as an instance-wise probability distribution
annotations.reason_zh: 论文明确研究标签分布学习，将监督建模为实例级概率分布，并以此为核心任务。

annotations.exact_quote: we study Federated Label Distribution Learning (Fed-LDL), where data isolation further induces heterogeneous annotation quality across clients
annotations.reason_zh: 论文研究联邦标签分布学习，多个客户端在数据隔离下协作训练，并通过服务器聚合更新。

annotations.exact_quote: high-fidelity label distributions that are costly to obtain and thus often noisy
annotations.reason_zh: 论文将标注质量差异与噪声标签分布作为核心研究条件，处理不准确的标签分布。

annotations.exact_quote: we study Federated Label Distribution Learning (Fed-LDL), where data isolation further induces heterogeneous annotation quality across clients, making local updates unevenly reliable and breaking sample-size-based aggregation (e.g., FedAvg).
annotations.reason_zh: 本文将客户端标签分布标注质量差异及不准确监督作为核心研究条件，并设计质量适应训练，符合弱监督中不准确监督的定义。
